translation: The Inner Classic says: When there is disease above, take [treatment] from below; when there is disease below, take [treatment] from above. It also says: For that above, treat below; for that below, treat above; this is so. Liu Zonghou said: Vaginal discharge is mostly rooted in yin vacuity and yang exhaustion, with the nutritive qi not ascending, the channels and vessels congealed and rough, the defensive qi sinking, and essence-qi accumulating and stagnating in the region of the extraordinary vessels of the lower burner, brewing and forming it.
